listings.description: There are neighbourhoods in London that carry a different weight. Belgravia is one of them — white facades, quiet grandeur, the kind of elegance that has never needed to prove itself.. Bergamot opens with effortless brightness, blackcurrant adding a whisper of depth. Freesia and lily of the valley move through the heart — delicate but never fragile, refined without effort. Vetiver and musk close with quiet authority, the signature of someone who was never trying to impress you.. . Belgravia — Royalty doesn't announce itself. . . Family: Woody Musk . Top Notes: Bergamot, Blackcurrant, Lemon. Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley, Freesia, Sandalwood, Caramel. Base Notes: Vetiver, Cedarwood, Moss, Musk.

Inspired by the quiet power of royalty, REGENT reflects leadership without excess — presence built on balance and refinement.. A vibrant opening of bergamot, mandarin, and grapefruit is sharpened by a touch of ginger, bringing clarity and energy. The heart reveals jasmine and orange blossom softened by the smooth elegance of orris, while ambergris, sandalwood, cedarwood, and musk create a warm, structured trail that feels timeless and composed.. Not loud. Just regal. This is REGENT. . Family: Hesperidic Ambery . Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Ginger, Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Orris. Base Notes: Ambergris, Cedarwood, Musk, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Tonka.

Light as wings — vibrant freedom captured in color and motion. . VEYRA bursts open with sparkling mandarin, pomegranate, and blackcurrant wrapped in Italian bergamot, creating a radiant and uplifting start. The heart blooms with Bulgarian rose and magnolia, softened by a playful caramel touch, before melting into a warm base of vanilla, peach, and ambergris warmth that feels luminous and graceful.. Bold. Feminine. Unapologetically free. This is VEYRA. . . Family: Floral Fruity . Top Notes: Mandarin, Pomegranate, Italian Bergamot, Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Bulgaria Rose, Magnolia, Caramel, Lily Of The Valley. Base Notes: Vanilla, Ambergris Scented, Peach, Ambrette.

Where Dubai’s bold energy meets Milan’s timeless elegance. . DUBAI : MILANO opens with a luminous burst of bergamot and tropical fruits, softened by a silky touch that feels refined yet modern. The heart introduces smooth leather wrapped in cypress and violet leaf, adding depth and sophistication inspired by Italian style. As it settles, vanilla, musk, and warm labdanum create a sensual trail — polished, confident, and effortlessly luxurious.. A journey in contrast. This is DUBAI : MILANO. . . Family: Fruity Leathery . Top Notes: Bergamot, Silk, Pineapple, Mango, Guava. Heart Notes: Cypress, Leather, Violet Leaf. Base Notes: Vanilla, Musks, Labdanum .

Modern heritage — where Dubai’s vibrance meets London’s quiet sophistication. . DUBAI : LONDON opens with aromatic lavender and pink pepper, lifted by a crisp citrus edge that feels fresh yet confident. A refined heart of orris, apricot, and hazelnut adds texture and elegance, before settling into a woody base of cedar, vetiver, and soft musk. Smooth, structured, and effortlessly stylish — a scent that moves between tradition and modernity.. Classic, with a contemporary pulse. This is DUBAI : LONDON. . . Family: Woody Spicy . Top Notes: Lavender, Pink Pepper, Citrus. Heart Notes: Orris, Apricot, Hazelnut. Base Notes: Cedar, Cashmeran, Musk, Vetiver .

Sunlit freedom — a vibrant escape from desert glow to ocean breeze. . DUBAI : MIAMI bursts open with juicy pear, plum, and sparkling bergamot, touched by bright lemon freshness. At the heart, soft rose and lily of the valley meet a playful caramel note, adding warmth without losing its airy charm. The dry down blends white musk and creamy vanilla into a smooth, luminous finish — youthful, radiant, and endlessly uplifting.. From golden sands to neon sunsets. This is DUBAI : MIAMI. . . Family: Fruity Citrus . Top Notes: Bergamot, Plum, Pear, Lemon. Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley, Caramel, Rose. Base Notes: White Musk, Vanilla .

Unbound by limits — a breath of freedom carried by the sea. . INFINA opens with a vibrant rush of bergamot, pink pepper, and cardamom, lifted by a cool marine breeze that feels expansive and weightless. In the heart, smoky incense and warm cashmere woods create depth without heaviness, while mossy amber and soft musk settle into a smooth, lingering trail that feels endlessly free.. Movement without restraint. This is INFINA. . . Family: Woody Marine . Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Marine, Cardamom, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Cashmere, Incense, Ambery. Base Notes: Musk, Ambery, Moss.

Balance in motion — freedom found between strength and softness. . LIBRAE blends aromatic spices and bright citrus into a refined opening that feels both bold and composed. A powdery woody heart unfolds with subtle florals, adding elegance and quiet confidence. As it settles, sandalwood, moss, and soft musk create a grounded yet airy presence — structured, timeless, and effortlessly free.. Where harmony meets independence. This is LIBRAE. . . Family: Oriental Woody . Top Notes: Spicy, Aromatic, Citrus. Heart Notes: Powdery, Woody, Floral. Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Moss.

A soft escape, where warmth meets quiet beauty. . FAIRYLAND opens with mandarin and bergamot, gently wrapped in a touch of cinnamon that adds a subtle glow. At the heart, rose and geranium blend with the earthy depth of cypriol, creating a floral composition that feels both airy and grounded. As it settles, musk, patchouli, and cedarwood leave a smooth, comforting trail that lingers with effortless ease.. Soft, warm, and gently captivating. This is FAIRYLAND. . . Family: Oriental Woody . Top Notes: Mandarin, Bergamot, Cinnamon. Heart Notes: Cypriol, Geranium, Rose. Base Notes: Musk, Patchouli, Cedarwood.

Everything falls into place — soft, radiant, complete. . HARMONY opens with a vibrant blend of apricot, peach, citrus, and tropical fruits, bringing a bright and uplifting start. The heart reveals a fresh floral mix of lily of the valley, rose, neroli, and freesia, adding clarity and lightness. As it settles, vanilla, white musks, and smooth woods create a clean, comforting trail that feels balanced and effortlessly refined.. Bright yet calm. This is HARMONY. . . Family: Floral Oriental Fruity . Top Notes: Apricot, Peach, Mandarin, Orange, Grapefruit, Blackcurrant, Pineapple, Coconut. Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley, Rose, Neroli, Freesia. Base Notes: Vanilla, White Musks, Cashmeran, Sandalwood, Cedar.

Close to the skin, like a moment meant just for you. . WHISPER opens with a soft blend of mango, pear, and mandarin, creating a smooth, luminous sweetness. The heart melts into muguet and orange flower, layered with a creamy milk accord that adds a comforting, velvety touch. As it settles, vanilla, musk, and cashmeran create a warm, delicate trail that stays intimate and quietly addictive.. Felt, not announced. This is WHISPER. . . Family: Oriental Floral . Top Notes: Mango, Mandarin, Pear. Heart Notes: Muguet, Milk, Orange Flower. Base Notes: Musk, Vanilla, Cashmeran.

Born from the belief that nothing is impossible, THRILLER delivers the ultimate adrenaline hit. A fresh and spicy combination of bergamot, saffron and pepper strikes fast, then melts into smoky leather and incense bringing darkness and intensity. As it settles, vanilla and sandalwood take over, smooth but relentless, like the moment you realize there’s no turning back. . A shared vision. . MAISON ASRAR × CAL COLOGNE drop the year’s most anticipated release. . Family: Aromatic Woody . Top Notes: Lemon, Cardamom, Bergamot, Saffron, Elemi, Pepper. Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Labdanum, Leather, Tonka Beans, Incense. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Benzoin, Amber, Musk, Vanilla, Cashmeran.

Strength, command, and presence. Vanguard opens with a crisp, confident freshness where apple, bergamot, and pineapple meet the sharp sparkle of grapefruit and pink pepper. A refined heart unfolds with carnation, ginger, and cardamom, adding warmth, spice, and controlled intensity. It settles into a commanding base of leather, ambergris, and woods, leaving a bold, authoritative signature that defines modern royalty.. Family: Chypre Leather . Top Notes: Apple, Bergamot, Blackcurrant, Grapefruit, Pink Pepper, Pineapple. Heart Notes: Carnation, Ginger, Cardamom, Lily of the Valley. Base Notes: Ambergris, Cashmere, Cedarwood, Leather, Moss, Musk.

Milky Way takes the idea of “creamy” and turns it into something elegant. Milk, caramel, and vanilla blend into a smooth, warm sweetness that never feels heavy — just soft, comforting, and quietly luxurious. It settles into a warm tonka glow that feels calm and deeply inviting.. Simple, warm, and beautifully creamy from start to finish. Family: Oriental gourmand . Top Notes: Caramel, Sweet milk, Plum . Heart Notes: Ylang - ylang, Jasmine, orris, Cashmere . Base Notes: Tonka beans, Vanilla, Sandalwood . .

Adorable is an elegant and sophisticated fragrance that combines Floral notes with Woody and Spicy accords. A brave opening of Rose is accompanied with Woody notes in the middle, which melts into a long lasting finale of Amber and Leather. . Family: Oriental Floral . Top Notes: Rose. Heart Notes: Woody. Base Notes: Ambery, Leather. Perfect for winter/fall and night.

When sweetness meets control. Vanilla Seduction opens with the soft bloom of plum and jasmine, unfolding into brown sugar and caramel over a deep trail of tonka and amber. Smooth, addictive, and impossibly refined — a scent that draws attention without asking for it. Confidence wrapped in warmth. . Family: Gourmand Sweet . Top Notes: Plum, Lily of the Valley, Jasmine. Heart Notes: Vanilla, Brown Sugar, Caramel. Base Notes: Tonka, Musk, Amber, Patchouli.

Where warmth turns into radiance. Vanilla Aura glows with citrus brightness before melting into ribbons of caramel and molten chocolate, resting on a veil of amber, sandalwood, and vanilla. Each note moves like light over silk — serene, golden, unforgettable. A fragrance of quiet strength and luminous grace. . Family: Gourmand Sweet . Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Lily of the Valley. Heart Notes: Caramel, Vanilla, Chocolate. Base Notes: Amber, Sandalwood, Tonka, Vanilla.

A darker chapter of the crown. Throne Eclipse unfolds with apple and clove, deepened by cinnamon and lavender, settling into a warm ambery trail of vanilla and cedarwood. Elegant, magnetic — the night side of power. . Family: Hesperidic Musky . Top Notes: Apple, Clove, Cardamom. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Geranium, Lavender. Base Notes: Vanilla, Ambery, Cedarwood .

Where luxury meets legacy. Throne stands as a symbol of grace and power — a floral oriental blend of mandarin and ambery roses wrapped in soft leather and sandalwood. A scent for those born to rule, not follow. . Family: Floral Oriental . Top Notes: Mandarin, Ginger, Ambery. Heart Notes: Rose, Jasmine, Leather, Ambery. Base Notes: Musk, Styrax, Sandalwood .

A fragrance born of noble blood — pure, enduring, and proud. Cardamom and incense meet the calm of florals and musk, anchored by oud and ambergris. Strength in heritage, grace in legacy. . Family: Fougere Ambery . Top Notes: Cardamom, Lemon, Incense, Pink Pepper, Tea, Juniper Berry. Heart Notes: Orris, Lily of the Valley, Rose, Jasmine. Base Notes: Musk, Oud, Tonka, Cashmere, Ambergris, Patchouli .

The horseman of grace — steady, instinctive, and free. Citrus and spice ride through lavender and musk, leaving a smoky trail of quiet strength. A scent that commands presence without a word. . Family: Citrus Woody Patchouli . Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Grapefruit, Pink Pepper Je, Apple. Heart Notes: Hybrid Lavender, Lily of the Valley, Ginger. Base Notes: White Musks, Cashmeran, Orcanox™ .

The desert’s prized mare — fierce, rare, unforgettable. Saffron and cocoa gallop through suede and praline before settling into oud and vanilla. Bold, sensuous, and born to reign. . Family: Oriental Woody Leathery . Top Notes: Saffron, Cinnamon, Cocoa. Heart Notes: Suede, Praline, Leather. Base Notes: Vanilla, Oud, Patchouli .

The noble knight of the sands — timeless and regal. Oriental woods and amber touched with sweet cane sugar and musk. A deep, elegant fragrance of legacy and honor. . Family: Oriental Balsamic Woody Spicy . Top Notes: Oriental Accord, Cashmere Wood, Vanilla Wood, Liquorous Accord . Heart Notes: Cedarwood, Amber, Cane Sugar . Base Notes: Musk, Tonka Beans, Labdanum, Sandalwood .

The spirit of the desert warrior — fierce yet noble. Warm honey and cinnamon melt into tobacco, tonka, and vanilla woods. A rich, enveloping scent of strength and quiet power. . Family: Aromatic Spicy . Top Notes: Lemon, Bergamot, Lavandin . Heart Notes: Cashmere, Cinnamon, Honey . Base Notes: Tonka, Jasmine, Tobacco .

A dream so bold, it became a blueprint. . Hilm begins with a radiant burst of mango and mandarin — ripe, golden, full of promise. Chamomile softens the edges, while coconut and jasmine unfold with gentle confidence. The dry down is rich and grounded — patchouli, caramel, and cedarwood leaving behind a quiet trail of ambition. Not imagined. Not wished for. Lived. . Family: Oriental Fruity . Top Notes: Mandarin, Mango, Orange, Chamomile . Heart Notes: Jasmine, Ylang-ylang, Coconut, Orris . Base Notes: Musk, Patchouli, Vetiver, Cedarwood, Caramel .

The scent of stories Dubai will never forget. . Bold, unapologetic, and rooted in depth — Hikaya is the past written in spice and gold. Praline melts into saffron like old streets holding new footsteps, while rose and caramel rise like warmth from familiar hands. It ends in a hush of vanilla and ambergris — a nod to the memories this city refuses to let fade. . Family: Oriental Gourmand . Top Notes: Bergamot, Saffron, Praline . Heart Notes: Rose, Caramel, Cashmere Wood . Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Ambergris .

Named after a city that never looks back — bold, fast, and always in focus. . This scent opens with sharp citrus: orange, mandarin, and bergamot. A crisp flash of grapefruit and ginger keeps things moving, before soft lily and musk smooth it out. Clean, modern, and unmistakably fresh. . DXB - Where bold architecture meets crisp clarity. . Family: Citrus Green . Top Notes: Orange, Mandarin, Bergamot . Heart Notes: Grapefruit, Ginger . Base Notes: Lily of the Valley, Musk .

Emerald evokes the deep greens of the forest, starting with a vibrant blend of woody accords and cashmere wood, moving into a heart of leathery sandalwood, and concluding with a base of fougere accord and amber for a truly majestic fragrance. . Family: Woody Spicy . Top Notes: Woody accord, Cashmere wood, Violet leaves, Pepper . Heart Notes: Dry amber, Leathery accord, Sandalwood . Base Notes: Fougere accord, Amber, Vanilla wood, Tonka beans .

Rubellite captures the essence of passion and vigor, beginning with rich notes of plum and blackberry, leading into a heart of patchouli and saffron, and ending with a warm base of ambergris and labdanum. . Family: Woody Ambery . Top Notes: Plum, Blackberry, Blackcurrant . Heart Notes: Patchouli, Saffron, Leather . Base Notes: Ambergris, Labdanum, Moss .

Larimar mirrors the tranquil beauty of deep space and galaxies, combining nutmeg and pink pepper with a heart of patchouli and lavender, finishing with a base of tonka and ambergris for a serene and sophisticated scent. . Family: Aromatic Ambery . Top Notes: Nutmeg, Pink pepper, Cardamom, Grapefruit . Heart Notes: Cashmere, Patchouli, Lavender, Leather . Base Notes: Tonka, Ambergris, Vetiver, Moss .

Soft chaos, sweet aftermath. It starts with a swirl of lychee, peach, and saffron — bright, flirtatious, untamed. Then comes the calm: incense, osmanthus, and cashmere pull the storm into something intimate. A creamy base of vanilla, cedar, and musk lingers like heat in the air. Seduction, redefined. . Family: Oriental Sweet. . Top Notes: Peach, Lychee, Davana, Saffron . Heart Notes: Cashmere, Incense, Osmanthus . Base Notes: Tonka, Musk, Vanilla, Cedarwood .

Freshness, in full motion. A wave of lemon, melon, and ginger breaks over lavender and crisp apple, rippling through marine accords and dry woods. The dry down is cool and steady — sandalwood and musk anchoring the energy in effortless calm. Cascade captures the feeling of water in flight. . Family: Fougère Marine . Top Notes: Lemon, Ginger, Melon . Heart Notes: Lavender, Apple, Marine Accord, Dry Wood . Base Notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Amber, Musk .

Where stillness holds power. Inspired by the serene depth of a valley after the rain, WADI opens with creamy coconut and juicy pineapple. Lavender and clary sage add a soft herbal contrast before melting into a musky blend of vanilla, tonka, and patchouli. Smooth, grounded, and quietly magnetic. . Family: Fougère Musky . Top Notes: Pineapple, Coconut . Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Lavender . Base Notes: Tonka, Vanilla, Patchouli .

Built on clarity. Driven by ambition. . Vision is the clean sharpness of a skyline drawn before it’s built. Crisp lemon and blackcurrant slice through the noise, grounded by basil and white tea — fresh, focused, and exact. Musk and moss hum quietly beneath, like the silent steps that move a city forward. . Family: Citrusy Fruity . Top Notes: Orange, Green Lemon, Blackcurrant . Heart Notes: Basil, Coriander, White Tea Leaves . Base Notes: Musk, Moss, Ambergris .

Omniya" (wish in Arabic) manifests the essence of longing with a lively mix of citrus and ozonic freshness, a floral heart, and a profound base of musk and leather, embodying the pursuit of dreams. . Olfactive Family: Woody Fresh . Top Notes: Citrus, Fruity, Ozonic, Spicy . Heart Notes: Freesia, Jasmine, Lily of the valley, Orris . Base Notes: Ambergris, Leather, Moss, Musk .

Qamar" (moon in Arabic), night meets light. This enchanting blend combines apple and pear with a floral heart, deepened by a base of vanilla and sugary notes, reflecting the glowing beauty of moonlight. . Olfactive Family: Floral Fruity . Top Notes: Apple, Pear, Lemon . Heart Notes: Gardenia, Jasmine . Base Notes: Ambroxan, Vanilla, Sugary .

"Nada" (dew in Arabic) offers a fresh start to any day, with crisp bergamot and mandarin mingling with ambery cedarwood and vibrant orange blossom, finished with a comforting base of musk. It’s like the first light of dawn. . Olfactive Family: Woody Ambery . Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Mango . Heart Notes: Ambery, Cedarwood, Orange blossom . Base Notes: Creamy, Musk, Patchouli .

Finished in gold, crowned with a bee, and made to stand out—just like its name. Oh Honey! opens with a rush of blackcurrant and spicy apple, wrapped in citrus and attitude. At the heart, smooth white florals and warm honey bloom into a sweet haze—elevated by cedar and vanilla, and grounded in soft woods. It’s sweet, but not soft. Bold, but never too much. . Family: Fruity Sweet . Top Notes: Blackcurrant, Spicy Apple, Citrusy . Heart Notes: White Flowers, Honey, Cedar . Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla, Orcanox .

Majesty moves with quiet power and effortless light. A vibrant burst of grapefruit lifts the opening, bright and full of presence, while vetiver brings a grounded, noble strength beneath it. Fresh yet commanding, luminous yet enduring — a fragrance that wears its crown without needing to announce it. . . Family: Hesperidic Ambery . Top Notes: Grapefruit, Ginger, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Rose, Jasmine, Orris. Base Notes: Vetiver, Ambergris, Sandalwood, Tonka, Musk, Patchouli.

Greatness isn’t claimed, it’s earned. Legacy is the scent of quiet power, a composition built on bold contrasts. Spicy ginger and crisp pear open with an electric energy, softened by the fresh zest of bergamot. In the heart, the delicate yet unwavering presence of orange blossom and jasmine speaks to timeless refinement. As it settles, musk, vanilla, and amber merge into a warm, distinguished aura, ensuring that every impression lasts far beyond the first. . Not just a scent. A statement. This is Legacy. . Family: Hesperidic Ambery . Top Notes: Ginger, Pear, Bergamot . Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Woody . Base Notes: Musk, Vanilla, Ambery .

The night is young, and the possibilities are endless. Date Night starts with a playful spark—orange blossom and blackcurrant swirl together like the thrill of catching someone’s gaze, while mango adds a juicy, irresistible touch. As the conversation flows, raspberry and lily of the valley bloom, soft and romantic, blending with the smooth allure of sandalwood. When the night turns intimate, marshmallow and ambergris linger like the memory of laughter, warmth, and a soft touch goodbye. Date Night is your partner for nights filled with chemistry, charm, and unforgettable moments. . Family: Floral Sweet . Top Notes : Orange Blossom, Blackcurrant, Mango . Heart Notes : Raspberry, Lily of the Valley, Sandalwood . Base Notes : Musk, Ambergris, Marshmallow .

A fragrance of distinction. Monarch blends the rich warmth of cardamom, peach, and cinnamon, unfolding into a creamy heart of jasmine and milk. The dry-down? A noble fusion of heliotrope, patchouli, and musk—smooth, sophisticated, and utterly majestic. Fit for those born to lead.. Family: Woody Fruity . Top Notes: Cardamom, Peach, Cinnamon. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Milk, Coconut. Base Notes: Heliotrope, Patchouli, Musk.

A fragrance that wears the crown. Imperial reigns with a bold citrus opening of lemon and mandarin, leading to a heart of spiced cumin and nutmeg—regal, untamed, unforgettable. Anchored by cedarwood and moss, it leaves a trail as commanding as its name. This is power, bottled.. Family: Woody Spicy . Top Notes: Lemon, Mandarin, Lily of the Valley. Heart Notes: Cumin, Nutmeg, Jasmine, Violet. Base Notes: Ambery, Cedarwood, Moss.

Vanilla Voyage is a journey of indulgence, where creamy vanilla meets the richness of caramel and honey, evoking a feeling of nostalgic sweetness. This gourmand delight wraps you in an irresistible warmth, creating an aura of comfort and charm. . Crafted to embody the spirit of exploration and sweetness, Vanilla Voyage takes its name from the seamless blend of notes that transport you to a world of tender memories and intriguing desire. A unisex gourmand masterpiece that leaves a delectable trail, perfect for creating unforgettable moments. . Family: Gourmand Sweet . Top Notes: Caramel, Buttery . Heart Notes: Jasmine, Tonka, Honey . Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Ambery .

Coffee Blend is a decadent symphony inspired by the irresistible charm of a velvety affogato: the creamy richness of vanilla ice cream immersed in a bold shot of espresso. The fragrance opens with the delicate sweetness of almond and milk, melting seamlessly into the dark allure of freshly brewed coffee. A heart of soft white flowers and warm amber adds a touch of elegance, while a base of caramel, nutty accords, and vanilla brings a luscious depth. True to its name, Coffee Blend is a sensory escape, perfectly balancing the bold and the sweet in a way that feels both indulgent and comforting. . Family: Gourmand Sweet . Top Notes: Sweet Almond, Milk, Coffee. Heart Notes: White Flower, Ambery, Liquorice. Base Notes: Musk, Caramel, Nut, Vanilla .

Rosé is a luminous interpretation of timeless elegance, crafted to embody the purity of water flowers and the sophistication of rose. Opening with a delicate burst of bergamot and blackberry, the fragrance transitions into a heart of lotus flower and the velvety essence of rose. The watery floral notes are complemented by a soft cedarwood and musk base, wrapping the senses in an aura of gentle refinement. True to the Maison Asrar philosophy of uncovering beauty in every detail, Rosé captures the radiance of fresh blooms reflected on still water—an exquisite symphony of nature’s most graceful elements. . Olfactive Family: Floral . Top Notes : Blackberry, Aqueous, Bergamot, Apricot. Heart Notes : Lotus Flower, Rose, Magnolia, Lily of the Valley. Base Notes : Musk, Cedarwood.

Gold Noir is a bold, unisex scent that opens with fresh top notes of grapefruit, leading to a heart of cashmere and smoky rose. The base of amber and vetiver ensures a lasting impression. Perfect for evening wear, Gold Noir is a distinctive scent that commands attention. . Olfactive Family: Woody Oriental . Top Notes : Grapefruit, Spicy. Heart Notes : Cashmere, Rose, Smoky. Base Notes : Ambery, Moss, Musk, Sweet, Vetiver.

Silver Elixir channels confidence and freshness, starting with a harmonious aromatic blend of lemon and bergamot. The opening notes transition into a smoky heart of incense and patchouli, while a robust base of musk and leather delivers a powerful finish. Ideal for those looking to make a memorable impression, Silver Elixir stands out with its audacious freshness. . Olfactive Family: Woody Spicy . Top Notes : Lemon, Aromatic, Pink pepper, Bergamot. Heart Notes : Spicy, Incense, Vetiver, Patchouli. Base Notes : Musk, Ambergris, Moss, Leather.

Illuminate your presence with Lumiere. The bright notes of bergamot and green lead to a heart of melon and pineapple, embodying youthful exuberance. The woody base, infused with vanilla and white musk, ensures a sophisticated finish. Step into the spotlight and let your presence shine brightly.. Olfactive Family: Oriental, Balsamic / Fruity / Woody . Top Notes : Bergamot, Green. Heart Notes : Melon, Pineapple, Gourmand accord. Base Notes : Woody accord, Vanilla, White musk.

Experience the allure of an elegant evening with Soirée. This fragrance blends rich notes of vanilla blossoms, praline, and plum, creating an inviting aroma. The Heart Notes of white flowers and ylang-ylang add an exotic touch, while the base of vanilla wood and ambergris provides a warm, lasting impression.. Olfactive Family: Oriental, Balsamic / Vanilla Musk . Top Notes : Vanilla blossoms, Praline, Plum, Toffee, Apple. Heart Notes : White flowers, Ylang-ylang, Heliotrope blossoms, Lavender blossoms. Base Notes : Vanilla wood, Ambergris scented, Caramel.. Size: 110ml .

Leo asserts its dominion with a bold blend of black pepper and leather, evoking the sheer power of the king of beasts. This fragrance captures the essence of leadership and authority, with a compelling heart of suede and styrax that commands attention. Grounded in a base of vanilla and ambergris, Leo offers a lasting impression of enduring strength and regal grace. Embrace the power within; Leo commands it.. Olfactive Family: Oriental Leather . Top Notes: Lily of the Valley, Black Pepper, Leather. Heart Notes: Suede, Styrax, Patchouli. Base Notes: Musk, Vanilla, Ambergris . Size: 100ml .

Masterpiece embodies luxury and uniqueness. With Top Notes of apple and cardamom, it opens with a fresh and spicy aroma. The heart of cinnamon and lavender adds a warm, floral depth, while the base of vanilla and cedarwood ensures a sophisticated finish.. Olfactive Family: Hesperidic Musky . Top Notes : Apple, Clove, Cardamom. Heart Notes : Cinnamon, Geranium, Lavender. Base Notes : Vanilla, Ambery, Cedarwood. Size - 100ml .

Timeless is a fragrance for the modern, fast-paced individual. It opens with the zesty notes of Italian bergamot and green lemon, leading to a heart of blackcurrant and rosemary. The base of ambergris and patchouli provides a long-lasting, aromatic finish. Ideal for everyday wear, Timeless is a dynamic scent that keeps up with your busy lifestyle. . Olfactive Family: Woody / Citrus / Spicy . Top Notes : Italian bergamot, Green lemon, Elemi. Heart Notes : Blackcurrant, Rosemary, Green apple. Base Notes : Ambergris scented, Patchouli. Size - 100ml .

Flair is a celebration of creativity and new art. With top notes of pink berries and grapefruit, it opens with a vibrant burst. The heart of lavender and coffee adds a unique depth, while the base of amber and vetiver ensures a warm finish. Perfect for those who appreciate artistic expression, Flair is a fragrance that stands out. . Olfactive Family: Oriental Woody . Top Notes : Pink berries, Grapefruit, Incense, Green watery. Heart Notes : Lavender, Nutmeg, Coffee, Galbanum. Base Notes : Amber, Cashmeran, Patchouly, Vetiver. Size - 100ml .

Rey , the embodiment of regal authority, mirrors the sovereign grace of a lion ruling its realm. It opens with a royal blend of bergamot and grapefruit, crowned with commanding heart notes of black pepper and aromatic tonka. The noble base of musk, ambergris, and vanilla envelops the senses in a scent fit for a monarch. . Olfactive Family: Fougere Ambery . Top Notes: Geranium, Bergamot, Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Tonka, Aromatic, Black Pepper. Base Notes: Musk, Ambergris, Vanilla .

Hunter embodies the lion’s relentless spirit, with vibrant top notes of bergamot and lemon that set the stage for a vigorous pursuit. At its core, cedarwood and patchouli merge, echoing the depth of the chase, while a rich base of caramel and musk captures the thrill of conquest. Embrace your moment; the hunt awaits. . . Olfactive Fa mily: Fougere Ambery . . Top Notes: Bergamot, Elemi, Lavender, Lemon, Pineapple. Heart Notes: Cedarwood, Geranium, Lily of the valley, Patchouli. Base Notes: Caramel, Musk, Tonka, Vanilla. Size: 100ml .

Luna captures the essence of a serene, moonlit night. With top notes of bergamot and peach, it opens with a sweet yet refreshing burst. The heart of rose and jasmine provides a romantic depth, while the base of patchouli and sandalwood grounds the fragrance with a warm, earthy finish. Ideal for intimate evenings and date nights, Luna is perfect for those who seek a touch of mystery and elegance. . Olfactive Family: Chypre Fruity . Top Notes : Bergamot, Peach, Magnolia, Orange, Gardenia. Heart Notes : Rose, Orange blossom, Jasmine, Freesia. Base Notes : Patchouli, Vanilla, Musks, Sandalwood, Vetiver.
